method: experimental gradient-weighted attention/value source-token decomposition; NOT official Grad-ECLIP
formula: ReLU(sum_h,i,c grad_z[h,i,c] * attention[h,i,j] * value[h,j,c]); discard source class token j=0
attention: original 3 heads; final block only; gradients through full downstream average pooling/MLP/LayerNorm
limitations: local first-order intermediate attribution; not a complete input attribution or demonstrated faithfulness; no loosened spatial weighting or official class-token formula
